philippines.title: Protest march kicks off vs Pax Silica, Trump in Asean meet
philippines.description:
LUCENA CITY, QUEZON, Philippines — More than a thousand faculty members, employees and students of the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) staged a campus-wide walkout on Thursday to oppose the controversial Pax Silica initiative and to protest the anticipated visit of United States President Donald Trump for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit next week. Pax Silica is a US-led multinational coalition launched in December 2025 to secure global supply chains for artificial intelligence, semiconductors, and critical minerals. philippines.title: 94 fresh troops boost Army division’s combat capacity in Mindanao
philippines.description:
CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, Philippines — Fresh from a grueling 30-day training on close-quarters combat and hostage rescue, 94 newly minted Army privates are officially joining the ranks of the 10th Infantry  Division to bolster its territorial defense operations in Mindanao. Maj. Ruben Gadut told the Inquirer the new troopers—93 men and one woman—capped off their 240-hour Operations Orientation Course at the 10th Division Training School in Mawab, Davao de Oro, on Thursday, Nov. 12. The new soldiers underwent rigorous training on tactical maneuverability and battlefield survival, Gadut said. READ: Troops sent to North Cotabato village to pacify warring MILF groups […]...
